rows: Swing; hold a direction to aim
Pitch; D-pad picks the pitch and location
D-pad + A/B to throw to a base

widgets.text: Licensed MLB players (2002 rosters). Each player has contact, power, speed and arm ratings; pitchers have stamina and a pitch set.
Lay off pitches outside the zone early in the count. Mix fastballs up with breaking balls low; tired pitchers lose speed, so check stamina and go to the bullpen.
Set the batting order and defensive positions before each game; platoon left/right batters against the opposing pitcher.
Season mode keeps standings and player stats.
Win your division and the playoffs to take the World Series.
